name: Thai Kit
description: Game-ready Thai street props as procedural Three.js source: each prop is a factory that builds a THREE.Group in code, with named pivots, sockets and colliders on root.userData.sculptRuntime.

items.name: 7-eleven-store-building
items.title: 7-Eleven Store Building
items.description: Real trademark: 7-Eleven / CP All. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance. Built on the shared 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m building module: detailed front elevation, plain rendered side and rear walls, no loose objects outside. The reference case for the shared module: a real standalone Thai 7-Eleven is close to this footprint, so nothing here is scaled down.
